event_name: Gerber Collision & Glass Route 66 NHRA Nationals presented by PEAK

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 85 degrees, relative humidity 52 percent, barometer 29.79 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,243 feet, track temperature 105 degrees.

Prock is 6 - 0 against Green in prior events. 

Green with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He is advancing to his sixth final and
second this season.

Hagan is 22 - 13 against DeJoria in prior events. 

Hagan with the starting line advantage and dropped a cylinder.  DeJoria chased him down in the lights for the
win.  She will give up lane choice to Green in the final.  A rematch of the Gainesville final.  This is her
18th final round and second this season.
